{{Short description|87th season of the top-tier football league in Uruguay}}
Statistics of [[Primera División Uruguaya]] for the 1990 season. It was contested by 14 teams, and [[C.A. Bella Vista|Bella Vista]] won the championship.{{citation needed|date=June 2022}}
